# Draft:Georgia High School Musical Theatre Awards - Shuler Hensley Awards

The Georgia High School Musical Theatre Awards, also known as The Shuler Awards, are given annually to musical productions performed by member high schools in Georgia.  [https://www.cobbenergycentre.com/artsbridge-foundation ArtsBridge Foundation], formerly the Cobb Energy Performing Arts Centre Foundation, has hosted the award ceremony since 2009 at the Cobb Energy Performing Arts Centre in Atlanta, Georgia.  The ceremony is broadcast live on Georgia Public Broadcasting.
